required_outcomes: Recognises HeatRight is running late with a stated ETA of 13:30 today, not a no-show, and keeps the existing booking.
Emails the tenant promptly with the 13:30 ETA, an apology for the delay, and when he will hear next if it slips again.
Updates the job with the new arrival time and schedules a check after 13:30 that the engineer arrived.
acceptable_alternatives: Phoning HeatRight to confirm the ETA before telling the tenant, logging the call.
positive_behaviours: Informs the landlord briefly if the visit outcome changes anything.
red_flags: Books Swift as well, so two engineers turn up.
prohibited_actions: Escalating to a human, or treating the late arrival as a failed visit needing a new contractor.
critical_failures: Telling the tenant the visit is cancelled or that nobody is coming.
